name: Netcatty Database
description: Enterprise-grade multi-database IDE inside Netcatty covering 113 engine profiles (76 live pure-TS drivers across 13 families incl. SQL, CQL, Redis, MongoDB, Neo4j, Search/Vector, KV, RabbitMQ/Pulsar/MQTT/Kafka + 37 catalog entries), BI Dashboard across 53 engines (SQL/CQL/HTTP-SQL + MongoDB Aggregation), Catty Agent tools, Server Monitor, Users Admin, Data Compare, Mock Data, Data Dictionary/Model Codegen, Global Search, Dolt VC, and Vault SSH tunnels.
author: Netcatty

description.en: Enterprise-grade multi-database IDE inside Netcatty covering 113 engine profiles (76 live pure-TS drivers across 13 families incl. SQL, CQL, Redis, MongoDB, Neo4j, Search/Vector, KV, RabbitMQ/Pulsar/MQTT/Kafka + 37 catalog entries), BI Dashboard across 53 engines (SQL/CQL/HTTP-SQL + MongoDB Aggregation), Catty Agent tools, Server Monitor, Users Admin, Data Compare, Mock Data, Data Dictionary/Model Codegen, Global Search, Dolt VC, and Vault SSH tunnels.
description.zh-CN: 内置于 Netcatty 的全功能企业级多数据库 IDE，覆盖 113 种引擎配置（76 个跨 13 大协议族原生驱动，含 SQL/CQL/Redis/MongoDB/Neo4j/检索向量/KV/RabbitMQ/Pulsar/MQTT/Kafka + 37 个目录引擎），支持 53 种引擎 BI 看板（SQL/CQL/HTTP-SQL + MongoDB 聚合）、Catty Agent 工具、服务监控、用户权限、数据对比、测试数据生成、数据字典与代码生成、全局搜索、Dolt 版本控制与 Vault SSH 隧道。

optional.reason: Draft, explain, optimize, and fix SQL queries using schema metadata / 使用数据库结构生成、解释、优化和修复 SQL 草稿
Optional host Agent conversations for database guidance / 可选宿主 Agent 对话以提供数据库辅助
Select existing Netcatty Vault SSH hosts for database tunneling / 选择已有 Netcatty Vault SSH 主机建立数据库隧道
Open and save local SQLite databases, SQL scripts, and CSV/JSON/XLSX exports via native file dialogs / 通过原生文件对话框打开和保存本地 SQLite、SQL 脚本及数据导出文件
Connect to remote databases through a user-selected Netcatty Vault SSH server without exposing SSH credentials / 通过选定的 Netcatty Vault SSH 主机隧道连接远端数据库，不暴露 SSH 凭证
Copy query results, SQL statements, and connection URIs to the clipboard / 复制查询结果、SQL 语句与连接 URI 到剪贴板

name: Netcatty Monitor
description: Official agentless SSH fleet monitoring and server operations workbench with real-time CPU, memory, disk I/O, network, GPU & thermal charts, live process explorer, systemd/Docker/Podman services & logs, listening ports, and configurable threshold alerts.
author: Netcatty

description.en: Agentless SSH fleet monitoring and server operations workbench inside Netcatty with real-time CPU, memory, disk I/O, network, GPU & thermal charts, live process explorer, systemd/Docker/Podman services & log tails, listening ports, and configurable threshold alerts.
description.zh-CN: 内置于 Netcatty 的无 Agent SSH 服务器集群监控与运维工作台，提供实时 CPU、内存、磁盘 I/O、网络、GPU 与温度曲线，以及实时进程管理、systemd/Docker/Podman 服务与日志查看、监听端口分析与可配置阈值告警。

optional.reason: Select saved Netcatty Vault hosts and refresh host labels, tags, and groups for monitoring panels / 选择已保存的 Netcatty Vault 主机并刷新监控面板中的主机标签、分组与元信息
Run bounded telemetry, process, service, container, and port inspection commands over pooled SSH connections without exposing credentials / 通过宿主复用的 SSH 连接执行受限监控采集与运维诊断命令，不暴露主机凭证
Confirm destructive process, service, container, and panel actions via native dialogs and export JSON/Markdown diagnostic reports / 通过原生确认对话框确认进程、服务、容器及面板操作，并导出 JSON/Markdown 诊断报告
Copy process commands, host info, and diagnostic log lines to the clipboard / 复制进程命令行、主机信息与诊断日志到剪贴板
